title: Caribbean Breeze | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Private Heated Pool and Gulf Views! 2 Separate Living Areas! Close to The Hub and Rosemary Beach! Bright and Spacious! Walk straight out your front door to Peaceful, 50 yds to Private Beach Access! 2 Living Rooms
description_expanded: Description: Caribbean Breeze by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 34 Clareon Drive Details: Caribbean Breeze is a bright, updated home just 50 yards from the beach access with 8 bedrooms, 7 baths, and comfortably sleeps 23. Guests can enjoy the private heated saltwater pool and gulf views. Walk straight out the front door to a quiet, private beach access, allowing you to avoid the traffic and crowds with plenty of room to set up your umbrella right next to the water - even in the summer! Two separate living areas (one on the ground floor) make the home great for large families. The ground floor also includes a king bed master suite with a new private bathroom (shower) and kitchenette, perfect for guests who prefer to avoid stairs. Enjoy the wonderful Gulf views from the expansive covered porches and living areas. The house comes with internet-connected TV’s, an Apple TV, games and puzzles, and DVD players. When you are not at the beach, you can relax and enjoy the beautifully landscaped yard that contains a large 24 foot by 12 foot newly paved and refinished, heated, saltwater swimming pool. The large, spacious lawn now also includes a real putting green making it the perfect place to play bocce ball or other lawn games or to work on your golf game. There’s even a basketball goal in the driveway for the kids and cornhole next to the swimming pool. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Private, Quiet, Gated Beach Access: 50 Yards -Private Heated Pool 24’ x 12’- Pool heat is available for an additional $280 (pre-tax). The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. -Pet Friendly- Pet Fee Applicable $350/per pet. Please contact Reservations prior to your stay. -Available For Winter Monthly Rentals- Contact our team with any questions regarding pricing for monthly winter rentals. -Parking Spaces: 5 spaces in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 12, High Top Seating for 6, and Bar Seating for 2 -Dual Function Carafe Coffee Ground + Keurig (K-CUP) Coffee Maker Available in Each Kitchen -Gas Grill Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 23 8 Bedrooms / 7 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Two Twin/Full Bunks with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 2: Full Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: King Bed with NEW On-Suite Bath (Shower) -Additional Bedding: (1) Queen Sleeper Sofa Living Area / Kitchenette -Laundry Second Floor: -Bedroom 5: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 6: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Third Floor: -Bedroom 7 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 8 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Additional Bedding: (1) Twin Sleeper Sofa Amenities Include: - 6 Complimentary Adult Bikes - Cornhole Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *Trailers and boats are not permitted per the community HOA.
